question_patterns: 這是什麼，白白軟軟、香香的小東西
為什麼玉米會變成爆米花
first_sentence: 這是爆米花！因為玉米裡的水變蒸氣就爆開。
facts: 玉米粒外殼很硬，裡面藏著一點水
加熱後，水變成蒸氣，壓力越來越大
外殼突然破開，玉米就膨起來
ask_back: 爆開以後，爆米花會變大還是變小？

bridges.has_cat: 貓咪聽到爆米花爆開的聲音，會嚇一跳嗎？

author: claude-haiku

en.first_sentence: This is popcorn! Steam from water inside makes it pop open.
facts: A corn seed has a hard shell with a little water inside.
When it gets hot, the water becomes steam and pushes harder.
Then the shell suddenly cracks, and the corn puffs up.
en.ask_back: Do you think popcorn pops more when it is hot, or cold?

bridges.has_cat: Would your cat jump when popcorn pops with a loud bang?
